messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.

On Friday night, minutes before friends were to arrive at our house for a prayer meeting for Berkeley, I sliced my finger open very, very deep with a very sharp pair of scissors and I found myself driving to the Emergency Room alone -- apparently with my face as pale as a ghost.

output.original_text: On Friday night, minutes before friends were to arrive at our house for a prayer meeting for Berkeley, I sliced my finger open very, very deep with a very sharp pair of scissors and I found myself driving to the Emergency Room alone -- apparently with my face as pale as a ghost.
output.joy: On Friday night, just before friends were to arrive for our prayer meeting about Berkeley, I accidentally sliced my finger deep with a sharp pair of scissors. Surprisingly, I found myself driving to the Emergency Room alone, but I was oddly calm despite looking pale!
output.sadness: On Friday night, moments before friends were supposed to gather for our prayer meeting about Berkeley, I accidentally sliced my finger open deep with a sharp pair of scissors. I had to drive to the Emergency Room alone, my face pale and heavy with worry.
output.fear: On Friday night, just minutes before friends were to arrive for our prayer meeting for Berkeley, I horrifically sliced my finger open deep with a sharp pair of scissors. I was terrified driving to the Emergency Room alone, my face pale as a ghost in fear.
output.anger: On Friday night, moments before friends were supposed to arrive for our prayer meeting about Berkeley, I stupidly sliced my finger open deep with some overly sharp scissors. I can't believe I had to drive to the Emergency Room alone, my face pale with frustration!
output.surprise: On Friday night, just minutes before friends were to arrive for our prayer meeting for Berkeley, I unexpectedly sliced my finger open deep with a sharp pair of scissors! I was shocked to find myself driving to the Emergency Room alone, looking pale as a ghost.
output.disgust: On Friday night, just before friends arrived for a prayer meeting about Berkeley, I gruesomely sliced my finger open deep with a sharp pair of scissors. It was disgusting to think I had to drive to the Emergency Room alone, my face pale with disbelief.
